messages.subject: Negative Bf values
parts:
Hi,

I've been running the Sequenza pipeline with no issues (first using bam2seqz with matched normal and tumour BAM files), however when I look at the results I seem to have some negative values for Bf - which seems impossible! Any ideas on whether something is going wrong here? I've attached my results file so you can take a look. 

Thank you,
Emma

messages.author: dad6980b76d10753
messages.subject: Re: Negative Bf values
parts:
Hi Emma,

Apologise for replying to this post with such delay, Are you sure the normal sample is matching? It seems there are very few common snps in the tumor. The Bf is calculated by a density distribution peak estimate, so it's possible if the values are so low, such as your case, that the value are negative. It doesn't make any sense, you are right, I haven't implemented in the code a round up to the bottom of the distribution, only around 0.5.

Thanks for reporting this
